about: The command line tool for deploying and running apps on Fly.io.

prs.title: Machines made through the AI tools get the right settings
prs.broken: Creating or running a Fly Machine through flyctl's AI assistant tools gave it the wrong start command and the wrong auto-stop setting.
prs.changed: The auto-stop option is now passed in a form the command line reads as one setting.
prs.matters: Machines started by AI assistants run the command the user asked for and stop the way they expect.
